reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and use it every day; copy-pasting works well enough for me. I don't see what three 'AI managers' do that I can't already do myself for 20 euros, and I don't have the hours to connect it to everything and teach it my business.
objection: I don't have time to set it up and learn another tool, and 100 credits a month sounds vague: I have no idea what that buys me or whether it runs out mid-month.
would_change_my_mind: A colleague-owner my size showing me it actually handles our customer support or follow-ups end to end after a one-hour onboarding they do for me, with a free month to prove it.
